subject: Scheduling: Hosted API Integration Workshop — SDKs, Streaming & Tools
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@medtech.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@medtech.co>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API Integration Workshop — SDKs, Streaming & Tools

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the great call last week. We'd like to set up a technical workshop to walk through a hosted API integration — specifically SDK usage, streaming responses, and function/tool calling so our engineering team can finalize the integration plan.

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Thu Apr 22, 8:30–10:00 AM PT

Attendees from our side: myself (backend lead), Priya Singh (platform), and two engineers (TBD). Can you confirm what the Redwood agenda would look like and who you'd have on the call (runtime/SDK/solutions)?

I attached our network checklist (network_requirements.xlsx) — should help your team validate any VPN/whitelist needs up-front.

Also, are there any pre-reads you recommend so our engineers can come prepared (e.g., batching, KV cache behavior, function/call examples)?

Best,
Alex
Alex Wu
Senior Backend Engineer, MedTech Solutions

Attachment: network_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@medtech.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API Integration Workshop — SDKs, Streaming & Tools

Hi Alex — thanks, this is perfect.

We can do Tue Apr 20 at 10:00 AM PT; that slot works for our SDK and runtime leads. Proposed high-level agenda:
1) 10:00–10:10 — Introductions & objectives (Vanessa)
2) 10:10–10:35 — SDK patterns and auth (Marissa)
3) 10:35–11:00 — Streaming & latency tuning (Karthik)
4) 11:00–11:20 — Tool / function calling + structured outputs (Grace if available)
5) 11:20–11:30 — Q&A / next steps / mutual action plan

Pre-reads we recommend:
- Short doc on SDK quickstart (we'll share link)
- A one-pager on batching & KV caching behavior for low-latency workloads
- Example repo with function-calling patterns (small sample)

I attached a draft agenda (agenda_v1.pdf). Can you confirm attendee list and whether recording is OK? Also confirm whether you prefer Zoom or a Teams meeting.

If Apr 20 works, we'll put a calendar invite on both sides and invite our runtime engineer (Karthik) and solutions engineer (Marissa). Grace O'Connor may join for the tool-calls section — I'll confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: agenda_v1.pdf (PDF)

Attendees (confirmed):
- Alex Wu (backend)
- Priya Singh (platform)
- Miguel Torres (engineer)
- Samantha Lee (engineer)

Thanks — looking forward.

Alex
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Wu <alex.wu@medtech.co>, Priya Singh <priya.s@medtech.co>
Date: 2027-04-13T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Hosted API Integration Workshop — Apr 20, 10:00–11:30 AM PT

Team — quick internal note and role assignments before the session on Apr 20: 

- Marissa: lead SDK walkthrough and auth patterns; have the small sample repo open and ready to share.
- Karthik: cover streaming internals, continuous batching implications, and latency tuning knobs (kv cache behavior + prefetched prefixes).
- Grace: demo a function-calling flow and a fallback policy example (how we fall back to a smaller model variant).
- Vanessa: facilitate intros, timekeeping, and collecting the mutual action plan.

External confirmed: Alex Wu, Priya Singh, Miguel Torres, Samantha Lee (MedTech Solutions). Alex will provide Zoom link; recording is OK.

I've created a shared folder and dropped the pre-reads and a short dependency list: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/medtech-integration
Please review the network checklist Alex shared (network_requirements.xlsx) and add any flagging notes to final_dependencies.md in the same folder.

I'll send the calendar event after we sync on final slide ownership (Marissa/Karthik/Grace). If any of you are unavailable or need to swap sections, reply-all so we can reshuffle before Friday.

Thanks — Vanessa

--
